Store in airtight contain- ers. Profile Dihydrostreptomycin is an aminoglycoside antibacterial with ac- tions similar to those of streptomycin (p.333). Since it is more likely than streptomycin to cause partial or complete loss of hear- ing it is not used parenterally in humans. It is not absorbed after oral doses, and has been given by this route for gastrointestinal infections. It is also used as the sulfate in veterinary medicine.
